brief:
Today, 14 November: Legs B. Then 15 November is a rest day (tonight is your sixth session since 8 November), and Push A follows on 16 November.

You wrote three notes on 12 November and you were right on all three. This is what changes.

Lateral raises: the program had one on three days of six, Push A, Pull A and Push B, so three of four nights in a row had one. The two cable sets on Pull A are gone (program version 12). Laterals now happen twice a week, on the push days only. That leaves side delts 6 direct sets a week, three per push day. On 23 August you said four lateral sets in one session seemed a lot, so the two notes together set the limit; the target is lowered to match instead of pretending.

The "Overhead db press" slot: you typed that name over the last Push B slot once, on 31 October. The app stores it against that slot at this gym and printed it on every Push B card since, and no review ever decided whether it belonged there. That was the miss. I still cannot tell which movement it was: 60 for 12 after four sets of shoulder press at 50 looks more like a one-dumbbell triceps extension than a press. Either way the slot is for triceps, so it is now the overhead dumbbell triceps extension: one dumbbell held in both hands, lowered behind your head, 2 sets of 10 to 12. If that is what you were doing at 60, start at 60; the card says 50 because the log does not say. It is a new name, so the old label will not come back.

Chest press "still at 150": the card asked 135, then 150, 150 because the review would not write a weight it had never seen you use on that machine. That was too timid. You did 150 for 11, 157.5 for 10, 165 for 9. From now on, when you earn a step the card shows the next weight, and if the stack does not have it you take the nearest one. Machine and isolation cards are also one weight on every set, with no light opener. Next Push A is 157.5 on all three, next Push B 165 on all three. Tonight's legs card follows the same rule.

Tonight, Legs B, in pounds, one weight per lift:
Barbell RDL: warm up as you like, then 185 for 9, 9, 8.
Leg extension: 150 for 11, three sets; 12 on all three earns 157.5.
Leg press, feet low: 200 for 11, three sets.
Leg curl: 160 for 10, three sets (150 for 12 on all three on 11 November). If 160 is not on the stack, take the nearest weight above 150 and log it.
Ab wheel: 10, 10, stop when your lower back arches.
Ab machine: 65 for 11, three sets.
Calf press: 300 for 12, three sets (you climbed to 300 for 12 on 3 and 7 November).

Cues: on the RDL, push your hips back and keep the bar against your legs. Do the leg curl and extension slowly on the way down.

Still open: which calf machines does the New York gym have (standing, seated, or neither)? One word in a note lets the calf slot move if it gets skipped again. Your logs are still stamped Meso 3, week 7, while the calendar says week 3 of the restarted block. If the phase tag at the top of the app is locked, the 25 November deload will not start by itself; "Automatic (by date)" clears the lock. No bodyweight logged since 23 August (207 lb). Conditioning: 2 to 3 easy sessions of 20 to 30 minutes a week are allowed in this block; nothing extra tonight.

block.why: Today is day 18 of the block restarted on 28 October at the New York gym, week 3 of 4. It builds to 24 November, the deload runs 25 November to 1 December, assessment 2 to 8 December, prep from 9 December, show 107 days away. Two nights arrived since the last review: Push B on 12 November and Pull B on 13 November. Nearly every lift moved on them: chest press to 165, reverse pec deck to 97.5, chest-supported row 60 for 9 on all four, close pulldown to 135, straight-arm pulldown to 52.5, reverse curl to 37.5. A build block should look like this. You also wrote three notes on 12 November and they are right in substance. First, laterals were on three days of six; the Pull A cable raise comes out. Second, a substitute you typed once had been carried for three Push B nights with no decision; that slot is now a named triceps lift. Third, the chest press card held you at 150 because the review would not write a weight it had not seen you use on that machine, and it opened with a lighter set. From now on an earned step gets written on the card (take the nearest weight if the stack lacks it), and machine and isolation cards are one weight on every set. That is why tonight's Legs B has no light opening sets; the deadlift keeps its climbing sets. Tonight's top weights are the ones the 13 November review set, because no new leg night has been logged since; only the openers change. The side-delt floor drops from 8 to 6 direct sets, so the program does not quietly fall short of its own target. Sessions are 19, 19, 20, 20, 21, 20 sets. The two leg days still share five lifts (leg press, leg curl, leg extension, calf press, ab machine). Every one of them is moving, so they stay through the last 10 days of this block, and the 9 December prep block gives Legs B its own lifts. Tonight is the sixth session since the rest day on 8 November, so 15 November is a rest day and Push A follows on 16 November.
